items.q: Then I got back home, and continued playing with Don Dunbar during the summer months, and gigged around home...

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, the Black theatre circuit around through the South. Yeah, we played theatres. Now and then we'd play a dance.
Then I got back home, and continued playing with Don Dunbar during the summer months, and gigged around home...
You were (?) had to go to school.
